sql: SELECT d.date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '150' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-195' GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of total passengers (y) for route 150 operated by HTX-195 (d.route_id = '150' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-195') at a daily granularity (d.date AS ds).
